description: Wildcard dependency authorization. When outgoing permissions are enabled, only services on an allow-list may request the wildcard 'all dependencies' value. A request from a service not on the allow-list that asks for the wildcard is rejected with a wildcard-not-allowed decision that names the offending service. A request from an allow-listed service is accepted. When outgoing permissions are disabled the check is skipped and every request is accepted. Decisions are emitted as neutral lines: 'result=accepted' on success, or 'error=wildcard_not_allowed' with the service name on rejection.
